33489562b9.q: What is Salty Cat and how does it compete with premium cat food brands while maintaining a value price point?
33489562b9.a: Salty Cat's thesis is to take a premium recipe, boil down everything and make it very simple to price it at value level. The company avoids high protein (which overworks a cat's liver), avoids added dyes (which overwork cats' kidneys), identifies all proteins transparently, and includes fish oils for coat health. The brand works with board-certified food scientists who have previously worked with Purina and Friskies to formulate recipes using quality U.S.-sourced vitamin packets and tuna additives for palatability.

2f9506825a.q: How did Salty Cat secure distribution with major U.S. retailers like Dollar Tree and Walmart?
2f9506825a.a: Dollar Tree was the door opener after Allison noticed empty cat food shelves during the pandemic when large CPG companies pulled out to focus on higher-margin retailers. She entered Dollar Tree by finding that vacuum in the value market. With Walmart, the company's strong Nielsen sales numbers from Dollar Tree sparked conversations, leading to a test of 500 doors in 2024, then expansion to 1,200 doors. For 2025, Walmart is giving Salty Cat one of the largest resets in its history for an emerging brand, tripling distribution to approximately 3,600 doors because demand exceeded supply expansion by over 600 percentage points.

7787c848d6.q: What enterprise resource planning system did Salty Cat implement to scale from $10 million revenue and beyond?
7787c848d6.a: Allison implemented a heavy-duty ERP (enterprise resource planner) in November 2024 to support growth to nine figures in revenue within four years. The ERP system handles accounting, cost of goods sold, all freight expenses and receipts, inventory tracking with RFID capability, product knowledge storage including packaging and unit size, purchase ordering, EDI data integration, and generates purchase orders and invoices automatically. This system also connects to AI and MCPs to pull data without manual processing, eventually becoming the company's centralized 'source of truth' and operating backbone.
